flowPrompt.prompt:
A scroll-stopping 8-second vertical (9:16) futuristic tech short, filmed as one smooth continuous take. A family on a space holiday floats by the giant window of an orbital lounge as a brilliant sunrise sweeps across the curve of the Earth.

SCENE: A sleek orbital lounge with curved white panels, soft handholds and a ring of potted plants, the dome window filled with the night side of Earth turning to day.
SUBJECT: An Indian family of four in soft white-and-teal travel suits floating gently beside a panoramic dome window in a calm orbital lounge.

ACTION:
0–2s: A thin line of blazing white sunlight bursts over the dark curve of the Earth, lighting up a little girl's face pressed close to a huge curved window.
2–6s: Golden sunlight spreads across the clouds and oceans below while the family drifts closer to the glass, the father steadying the floating girl as their faces glow warm.
6–8s: The whole lounge fills with golden light, the family silhouetted against the shining blue planet as the sunrise line rolls across the continents. The final frame holds steady.
Movement: Machines and vehicles move smoothly with believable mass and momentum. Any people move naturally and calmly in the background.

CAMERA: Close side angle on the girl at the window, ending behind the family; slow pull-back with a gentle drift around the family; 35 mm lens; smooth and stabilized.
LOOK: Ultra-realistic cinematic sci-fi realism with a premium commercial look. Sleek premium sci-fi commercial look, glowing holographic accents, crisp HDR detail and a satisfying reveal moment. Lighting: dark cabin lit by a sudden sweep of golden sunrise from the window. Color grade: deep blues turning to radiant gold with soft white interiors. Effects: realistic Earth limb, thin atmospheric glow and gentle zero-gravity hair float.

SOUND: Off-screen voice-over by a confident Indian male narrator with a clear, slightly deep voice, speaking Hindi in an awe-filled and tender tone: at 1.3s "Space station से रोज़ करीब 16 sunrise!", then at 4.9s "सोचिए, ये नज़ारा family के साथ!". Best quality: use Frames to Video with the image you made from the Image Prompt as the first frame.

If Flow says “might violate our policies”: wait 5–10 minutes and try the same prompt once more (busy servers fail too). If it fails again, report the video number.
Silent result? Add a track from YouTube Studio's Audio Library, never a commercial song.

thumbnail.prompt:
Scroll-stopping YouTube Shorts cover image, vertical 9:16 (1080×1920). A Naga elder by the fire with children as a glowing hornbill made of light flies across the bamboo wall.
SUBJECT: A smiling Naga grandfather in a traditional red-and-black shawl, a small palm-sized AI projector glowing amber on a wooden stool, and animated light drawings across the bamboo wall.
BACKGROUND: Inside a traditional bamboo-and-thatch house in a Nagaland hill village at night, with a central hearth fire, smoked wooden beams, woven baskets and children sitting cross-legged on the floor, simplified and softly blurred for depth.
HEADLINE TEXT: the words "Roshni Wali Kahani" written in extra-bold condensed sans-serif (Anton / Bebas Neue style), white with a cyan glow outline, large and centered in the upper third, spelled exactly as written, crisp and easy to read on a phone. This headline is the only text in the image.
COMPOSITION: subject big and close in the middle and lower two-thirds, clean uncluttered space behind the headline, strong contrast between subject, background and text.
LIGHTING & COLORS: Warm flickering firelight with a soft amber and gold projection glow, with a rim light that separates the subject from the background; palette: electric cyan, deep navy and warm orange accents.
LOOK: Sleek premium sci-fi commercial look, glowing holographic accents, crisp HDR detail and a satisfying reveal moment. Sharp, high detail, polished professional finish.
thumbnail.negativePrompt: blurry, low resolution, misspelled words, extra words, distorted letters, watermark, logo, extra fingers, distorted face, cluttered background, cartoon, toy-like, plastic look, cluttered sci-fi clichés, gloomy ruins

thumbnail.firstFrameHook: The first 0.5 s already shows the hook, starting on a strong frame: Close-up of an elder's weathered hands moving expressively in the firelight; behind him a glowing hornbill made of light suddenly spreads its wings across the woven bamboo wall.

seo.description:
सोचिए एक AI जो गाँव के बुज़ुर्ग की सुनाई लोककथा को सुनते ही दीवार पर चलती-फिरती रोशनी की तस्वीरों में बदल दे। Nagaland जैसी जगहों की मौखिक कहानियों को अगली पीढ़ी तक पहुँचाने का यह एक AI innovation concept है।

An AI storytelling concept that turns a Nagaland folk tale into animated light projections on a bamboo house wall.

🤖 यह वीडियो AI से बनाया गया है — visuals & audio AI-generated with Google Flow (Veo). It visualizes a concept or vision of the future, not an existing product unless stated.

ऐसे ही future tech Shorts के लिए channel को subscribe करें 🚀
